BiblicalUsage: Nekeb is a town on Naphtali's border, named once in the list of the tribe's boundary towns between Adami and Jabneel. It is a marker on the map, nothing more, and its whole place in Scripture is to say: the land ran this far.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the marker towns matter, because God measured out the inheritance town by town and none of it was left vague.
